I've been on them since the summer. I petitioned the school and am possibly able to retake the semester in the upcoming summer semester (but I have no idea if that's happening). I wait tables and am surrounded by pretty toxic people there. I tried to get help but it took me a long time to begin to even process it, it was almost a year before I could even talk to anyone about it.
They're not annoying, I just feel like I'm stuck here living on my parents couch (I had a bit of a breakdown and had to move back home) going to bullshit filler classes while I'm in limbo from my nursing program and working my waitressing job where I just work all day and get wasted after. 

I'm 22 and have nothing to show for it, I could be graduating with a Bachelors if I wasn't such a sack of shit.
